finding: Complete March 5 Embassy item styles Fahd King and reports yesterday chairing one session. March 4 event date is resolved directly, but no PM office is named. Rejected as anchor; explicit October 2004 styling becomes anchor.
March 11 Embassy item independently calls Abdullah Deputy Prime Minister, chairing today. It demonstrates why presiding does not identify a PM.
Dateline October 3, 2004; first paragraph explicitly styles Fahd رئيس مجلس الوزراء. Separate Military Service Council chairing by Crown Prince does not change the named PM observation.
Entire main item names King Fahd as chair of that afternoon session, without naming the PM office. Source claim retained; additional PM observation removed. Unread additions not used.

Complete A/194 names issuing Abdullah, continues all members of the Council in their posts under our chairmanship, separately appoints deputy PM and directs PM execution. Operative standing head of Council, not a single session; attestation only, no effective boundary.

A/29 names Abdullah and reconstitutes the whole Council under our chairmanship. The order effective-from-date clause concerns reconstitution, not initial office accession. Attestation remains March 22, 2007.
Entire main item reports King Abdullah chairing the dated budget session, with no independent PM office identification. It remains a dated institution event only.

Corrected-send header in metadata and full A/54 operative text name Salman, continue Council members under our chairmanship, separately appoint deputy PM. Standing institutional head observation; no initial effective-day inference.

Full recorded first addition names Salman and reconstitutes the whole Council under our chairmanship, then separately lists deputy PM. Hijri order date 9/4/1436 and portal filing metadata support recorded January 29, 2015 observation; no effective-day clause assumed.

Entire A/138 portion read through Salman signature. December 27 dateline and order 20/4/1440; whole Council reconstituted under our chairmanship, with MBS separately deputy PM. Remaining unrelated orders are outside imported scope.
May 17, 2022 dateline and first paragraph expressly name Salman as King and رئيس مجلس الوزراء. No end inferred from later MBS appointment.
Full A/61 explicitly appoints MBS PM by exception to Article 56. Date line/number/First/Third match; notification clause is not an explicit effective day.
A/61 Second reserves chairing of sessions attended by the King. This is neither a PM office grant nor PM tenure end.
Full A/62 read: member 1 names MBS Crown Prince and PM; order reconstitutes Council. Same-day corroborating holder observation, no second accession.
September 27 dateline/first paragraph name King Salman chairing a session. Later filing time does not establish event chronology against A/61. No PM styling.

Umm al-Qura page article date October 7, 2022 and complete A/61 text match. April 29, 2025 is separate capture-era site header. Publication is not an office attestation or effective-day boundary; not a scanned gazette issue.
October 25 dateline/first paragraph explicitly name MBS Crown Prince and PM presiding that day. Does not prove first-ever chaired session or continuous tenure.
June 16, 2026 dateline/first paragraph explicitly style MBS Crown Prince and PM. Point observation only; existing August 13 accepted claim remains unchanged and no continuity to cutoff inferred.
